description: Request-bound Spring formals stay sources while the injected response, request and principal formals around them do not: @RequestParam, an unannotated String, and @RequestBody reach their sinks, and a servlet request formal is a source only through getParameter.

expected.notes: @RequestParam name reaches the response writer; the source is the bound formal, not resp
unannotated String owner is bound from the query string
the servlet request formal is a source through its accessor label
